svg.title: UniAD per-layer feature residual and locked fusion path
svg.desc: At inference, input and reconstructed features are compared at each selected layer. Locked resize, fusion, aggregation, calibration, and threshold turn residuals only into a candidate signal.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, sans-serif

svg.text: inference：同一 ROI 在每個 selected layer 比較 F_l 與 F-hat_l，才留下 feature residual

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, sans-serif

svg.text: 每層 residual 經 locked resize / fusion / aggregation 才形成 candidate map；它仍不是缺陷類別、機率或 raw-pixel truth
